findings.evidence: log.error includes error_message=str(cause) for SDK retrieval errors; if an SDK exception ever embeds request details, they go to stderr structured logs. The comment acknowledges this and stdout never shows the message; acceptable, but worth confirming the SDK error types are safe when the ticket F-
findings.title: str(cause) logged verbatim

findings.evidence: When pipeline.report succeeds for a no-cause BatchStillProcessing, the printed report is the durable one whose failure_reason stays unset, while with a cause the reason is overwritten onto the printed copy; the durable record itself is never given the exit-5 reason. This is deliberate per the tests
findings.title: Fallback report may diverge from durable report

findings.evidence: SDKExtraction.collect assigns last_error = exc at line 186 on retrieve failure, but does not reset last_error = None in the else block at line 187 when client.messages.batches.retrieve succeeds. When an initial retrieve failure is recovered on subsequent iterations and the batch remains in progress
findings.title: Stale retrieve error chained on batch wait expiration
